Regarding request to Union Government to restart the MGNREGA Scheme in West Bengal

SHRIMATI JUNE MALIAH (MEDINIPUR): Thank you, Madam. Sorry my voice would not sound the normal way, thanks to the Delhi pollution. It has got the better of my voice. Madam, the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme, the MGNREGA, has been stopped in West Bengal, depriving nearly 59 lakh beneficiaries. Under the scheme, the Union Government continues to owe the State more than Rs. 43,000 crore in pending payments. 

The Calcutta High Court, in its recent judgment, directed the Union Government to resume MGNREGA Scheme operations in West Bengal by 1st August, 2025. Despite this clear order, the Union Government has neither restored the Scheme nor released the funds due to the State?s workers. Instead, it filed a petition before the Supreme Court challenging the High Court?s order.

In a way, even the Supreme Court stood with the Mamata Banerjee Government and upheld the decision on resumption of the MGNREGA Scheme. In total, the Union Government?s outstanding dues across various commitments amount to nearly Rs 2 lakh crore, Madam.

Depriving States of their rightful dues, shatters the foundation of cooperative federalism and the very ethos of the Constitution. Thus, I request, I urge rather, the Union Government to restart the MGNREGA Scheme and disburse the amount owed at the earliest. Jai Bangla.

Regarding developing Agra as IT hub

श्री राजकुमार चाहर (फतेहपुर सीकरी): माननीय सभापति महोदया, धन्‍यवाद। मैं आपके माध्‍यम से सरकार का ध्‍यान उत्‍तर प्रदेश के आगरा शहर की ओर दिलाना चाहता हूं। आगरा में ताजमहल है और ताजमहल बहुत ही खूबसूरत है। लेकिन, ताजमहल की खूबसूरती आगरा की जनता के लिए श्राप बन गई है। इसका कारण यह है कि ताजमहल की खूबसूरती न चली जाए, इस कारण से वहां Taj Trapezium Zone (टीटीज़ेड) और एनजीटी है। टीटीज़ेड और एनजीटी के कारण आगरा में न तो उद्योग लग पाते हैं और न ही फैक्‍ट्रीज़ लग पाती हैं। आगरा का नौजवान बेरोजगार घूम रहा है। 

मैं आपके माध्‍यम से सरकार का ध्‍यान दिलाना चाहता हूं कि आगरा में दिल्‍ली से आगरा तक एक्‍सप्रेसवे है और लखनऊ से आगरा तक एक्‍सप्रेसवे है। आगरा से ग्‍वालियर के लिए भी नया एक्‍सप्रेसवे बन रहा है और आगरा से जयपुर के लिए भी एक्‍सप्रेसवे है। आगरा दिल्‍ली से बहुत नज़दीक है। हमारे पास एक ही रास्‍ता बचता है। वह एक ही रास्‍ता यह है कि फैक्‍ट्री और उद्योग तो बाध्‍यता के कारण लग नहीं सकते, लेकिन पूरे देश भर का आईटी का हब आगरा में बनाया जा सकता है। 

अत: मेरी आपके माध्‍यम से सरकार से यह मांग है कि आगरा के बेरोजगारों को ध्‍यान में रखते हुए और आगरा की जनता के हित में आगरा को आईटी का हब बनाया जाए, जिससे वहां के लोगों को न्याय मिल सके और ताजमहल की खूबसूरती भी इसी तरह बनी रहे। धन्‍यवाद।

Regarding expeditious approval of work related to National Highway-373

SHRI SHREYAS M. PATEL (HASSAN): Thank you, hon. Chairperson, Madam. I rise to highlight an urgent matter concerning my constituency Belur-Hassan section of National Highway-373. Although work has already been awarded and an agreement has been executed, the project has not been grounded due to the non-approval of revised cost estimate. At present, it is pending with the Regional Officer, Bengaluru to review the land acquisition award. 

Due to the administrative delay, the appointment date has not been declared and the agency is unable to commence the work. This stretch is one of the most important corridors in Hassan district, which is extensively used by local commuters, tourists, and farmers. The road condition has deteriorated significantly following successive monsoons and heavy vehicular movements. 

Madam, through you, I request the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways to ensure expeditious approval of revised cost estimate so that the project may be grounded at the earliest. Thank you, Madam.

Regarding establishment of a medical college in Rajsamand Parliamentary Constituency

श्रीमती महिमा कुमारी मेवाड़ (राजसमन्द): सभापति महोदया, धन्‍यवाद। मैं यहां से अपने राजसमन्‍द परिवार को नमस्‍कार करना चाहती हूं। मेरे संसदीय क्षेत्र राजसमन्द राजस्थान के अंतर्गत आने वाले नाथद्वारा विधानसभा के गुन्जोल राजस्व ग्राम में मेडिकल कालेज की स्थापना के लिए राज्य के बजट वर्ष 2023 में घोषणा हुई थी और भूमि आवंटन भी किया गया था, परन्तु अभी तक भवन निर्माण प्रारम्भ नहीं हो सका है। इसका क्या कारण हो सकता है?

मेरा संसदीय क्षेत्र जनजातीय बाहुल्‍य क्षेत्र है, विशेषकर नाथ‌द्वारा विधानसभा से लगे क्षेत्रों, यथा भीम व कुम्भलगढ़ में भील इत्यादि जनजातीय जनसमुदाय हजारों वर्षों से रहते आ रहे हैं। जहां इन क्षेत्रों में नए मेडिकल संस्थानों का निर्माण कर स्वास्थ्य सेवाओं के विकास की आवश्यकता है, वहीं मौजूदा मेडिकल संस्थानों में नर्सिंग स्टाफ व डाक्टरों की संख्या में वृद्धि के साथ उच्च स्तरीय मेडिकल सुविधाओं का विस्तार करना भी बेहद जरुरी है। जब गुन्जोल राजस्व ग्राम में राज्य के बजट के माध्यम से मेडिकल कालेज के निर्माण को स्वीकृति प्रदान कर दी गई हो तो कोई कारण नहीं बनता है कि इस मेडिकल कालेज के निर्माण में आने वाली बाधाओं को दूर न किया जा सके, जबकि क्षेत्र जनजातीय बाहुल्‍य क्षेत्र हो। मेडिकल कॉलेज निर्माण में आ रही विभिन्न बाधाओं और मौजूदा स्वास्‍थ्‍य संस्थाओं में नर्सिग स्टाफ सहित आधारभूत मेडिकल सुविधाओं की कमी के कारण जनता, विशेषकर नाथ‌द्वारा और उससे लगे हुए जनजातीय बाहुल्‍य क्षेत्र, जैसे भीम और कुम्भलगढ़ इत्यादि में स्वास्थ्य सेवाओं की आसान उपलब्धता पर गम्भीर असर पड़ने की प्रबल सम्भावना है। इसके साथ ही नाथद्वारा और उसके आसपास क्षेत्रों में उच्च स्तरीय स्वास्थ्य सुविधाओं के विस्तार के लिए यथासंभव नीतिगत प्रयासों को किया जाना अत्यधिक जरुरी है। 

मेरा निवेदन है कि यह कार्य जरूर किया जाए।

Regarding construction of rural roads in Ghosi Parliamentary Constituency under Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)

श्री राजीव राय (घोसी): मैडम, मौका देने के लिए आपका धन्‍यवाद। मैं आपका ध्‍यान अपने संसदीय क्षेत्र में सड़कों की जर्जर स्थिति की ओर आकर्षित करना चाहता हूं। हमारे यहां प्रधानमंत्री सड़क योजना में पिछले चार सालों से एक भी सड़क पास नहीं हुई है। इस बार भी जितनी लिखकर दी हैं और जितने सर्वे करवाए हैं, उनमें से किसी का भी अप्रूवल नहीं हुआ है। जहां तक हमें जानकारी है कि जो नई स्‍कीम आई है, उसके तहत तो यह नहीं हो सकता है कि कोई खड़ंजा या ईंटें आनी हों। पुरानी सड़कों के संबंध में दिशा की बैठक में अधिकारी कहते हैं कि हमने बजट मांगा है, लेकिन लखनऊ से बजट नहीं आ रहा है।

मैं उदाहरण के लिए बताना चाहता हूं कि जिन सड़कों को हमने बनाया था, उनमें कोपागंज और कसारा गांव के लिए चार सालों से सड़कों के लिए योजना बन रही है। इसके बनवाने के लिए पता नहीं कितने दावे हो गए हैं, पुनर्निर्माण में गई है, लेकिन अभी तक उसका निर्माण ठीक ढंग से नहीं हुआ है। दोहरीघाट, मधुवन के साथ ही अन्‍य सारी सड़कों की स्थिति ऐसी है कि वहां से मरीज अस्‍पताल जाना चाहे तो रास्‍ते में ही मर जाए। मैं केवल सड़क के लिए नहीं कहना चाहूंगा, क्‍योंकि जब डॉक्‍टर बैठा हो, तो अपनी बीमारी जरूर बतानी चाहिए। यहां पर दोनों डॉक्‍टर्स बैठे हैं। यहां पर रेल मंत्री जी भी हैं और छोटे वाले डॉक्‍टर भी बैठे हैं। आपने मुझे कई बार सदन में आश्‍वासन दे दिया, कमरे में भी आश्‍वासन दे दिया, लेकिन अभी मऊ को कुछ नहीं मिला है। मैं डॉक्‍टर साहब से उम्‍मीद करता हूं कि आप इसको कर दीजिए। हमारे यहां न सड़क है, न रेल है, न उद्योग है, न रोजगार है और न ही शिक्षा का कोई उच्‍च संस्‍थान है। 

मैं सरकार से निवेदन करता हूं कि मऊ पर विशेष कृपा की जाए। अगर आप वहां से बार-बार हार रहे हैं, तो इसका मतलब यह नहीं है कि उस जिले या उस लाेक सभा को अपनी लिस्‍ट से बाहर कर दिया जाए।

Regarding release of special Central funds under AMRUT 2.0 for the infrastructure development for damage caused by heavy rains and Cyclone Montha

DR. KADIYAM KAVYA (WARANGAL): Hon. Madam Chairperson, I draw the urgent attention of the House to the devastating damage caused by heavy rains and Cyclone Montha in October, 2025 across Greater Warangal Municipal Corporation limits. Over 200 mm rainfall submerged 45 colonies including Shivanagar and DK Nagar, and key roads -- Pothana Road, Bhadrakali-Polytechnic stretch, Mulugu Road, Bondi Vagu and the 80 feet road at Pochamma Maidan -- have been washed away, turning into rivers of slush with deep craters. Nearly 1,200 residents were evacuated to 12 relief camps. Incomplete drainage works under AMRUT and Smart Cities Mission -- only 66 per cent of Rs. 1,800 crore completed -- exposed systemic failure in planning and maintenance.

I urge the hon. Minister of Housing and Urban Affairs to release special Central funds under AMRUT 2.0 for immediate resurfacing and flood-resilient repairs of internal roads by March 2026, order a high-level audit of GWMC infrastructure and integrate real-time monitoring, and announce an immediate relief package of Rs. 100 crore for road restoration. Warangal, a heritage Smart City, deserves resilient roads, not recurring ruin. Thank you.

Regarding issue of pensioners with new guidelines titled 'Validation of Pension Rules 2025'

SHRI MALAIYARASAN D. (KALLAKURICHI): Hon. Madam Chairperson. Vanakkam. I wish to raise an important issue in this august House concerning several lakhs of pensioners and family pensioners who are in a mindset filled with fear and sadness. Recently new guidelines titled 'Validation of Pension Rules 2025' were issued by the Union Government through a Gazette Notification dated 29 March 2025. This guideline accords approval to the past administrative actions of the Government as regards pension. Giving pension is not an act of sympathy. Rather it is the sum of money provided in a rightful and legal manner to the persons who served this country with dedication. Moreover, I must say that the Associations of Pensioners were not consulted before issuance of such Guidelines. In the present situation where the livelihood expenses have increased manifold, any change in their rights including monetary rights will drastically and deeply impact the lives of our Senior Citizens. 

Hon. Madam Chairperson, therefore, I urge upon the Government, through you, that they should issue a clarification on the Objectives, Consequences and Tradition pertaining to the announcement with regard to Validation of Pension Rules, 2025. The Government should give an assurance in this House that no pensioner or no family pensioner would be affected or loose their rights due to Validation of Pension Rules 2025. I urge that the Union government should hold consultations with the Pensioners' Associations recognized at the national level. I also urge upon the Government that a redressal mechanism should be set up, as a special case, to address the grievances of Pensioners due to this new Guideline. Thank you for this opportunity.

Although the Supreme Court directed the central government to restart the MGNREGA work, it has not yet done so. Thank you very much for giving me this opportunity to speak. Jai Bangla.

Regarding need of 8-hour shift to young doctors who are pursuing MBBS-MD

SHRI BAJRANG MANOHAR SONWANE (BEED): Honorable Chairperson, Thank you Sir.

Today I am drawing the attention of this House to a very painful and thought-provoking reality. MBBS-MD students who are pursuing medical education have to work for at least 36 hours. The unbearable work pressure put on them is beyond human limit. In most of the hospitals in the country, these young doctors have to work for 36 to 48 hours continuously without any rest. This is unpleasant to hear but, this is their professional reality.

In other fields, the work limit of 8 to 12 hours is followed, so why inhuman rules for these doctors who are pursuing MBBS-MD? A common man cannot even drive a vehicle safely after staying awake for 24 hours, because the result is fatigue, restlessness, stress. On the other hand, the doctors who are in the medical field provide continuous medical services despite lack of sleep, mental pressure, physical fatigue. This is an injustice to their lives and safety.

A tired doctor not only endangers himself but also the patients who come to him for medical treatment. When doctors get tired, the entire health system gets tired. When doctors collapse, the entire medical system collapses.

Today, I request the House that we need to consider the lives, health, and safety of these young doctors seriously

The 36 to 48-hour shifts they are doing should be stopped immediately and they should be given an 8-hour shifts so that their work can be limited. This is my humble request to you that the injustice done to doctors should be stopped immediately. 

Thank you.

Regarding need to take action to control air pollution

SHRI B. MANICKAM TAGORE (VIRUDHUNAGAR): Thank you, Sir. I rise to draw the attention of the house to a public health emergency that is putting millions of Indians at risk everyday. Delhi is breathing toxic and hazardous air. Children are missing from school. Workers cannot stand outdoors. Hospitals are overflowing with respiratory and cardiac cases. People are not just suffering, they are choking. What is the Government's response? There is no strict enforcement, no clean air plan and no accountability. Instead, we see cosmetic gimmicks. Instead of working hard to reduce pollution, the Delhi Government is working hard to manipulate AQI numbers by spraying water near monitoring stations. Please wake up. Spraying water near sensors will not save our children's lungs. Managing the numbers is not the same as managing the pollution. Year after year, the same excuses are repeated. Weather, wind, farmers, neighbouring States, everyone is blamed except those responsible for enforcement. 

Meanwhile, other nations have shown that decisive action works. Beijing, for example, was a more polluted city than Delhi a few years back. It cleaned its air through strict deadlines, industrial reforms, electrification of transport, and real accountability. Where is our accountability? Why do thermal power plants within 300 kilometres of Delhi still operate without FGD systems? Why is the public transport fleet stuck with the EV infrastructure moving at a snail?s pace? Why are industrial polluters allowed to operate with immunity? Why do construction sites openly violate dust norms every day? 

Sir, citizens are not asking for miracles. They are asking for the basic right to breath. I demand an immediate, time-bound, Beijing-style clean air emergency plan. There are six points I want to raise before you. One, mandatory FGD installation in all thermal power plants within 12 months, with no more extensions. Two, 50 per cent electrification of public buses in NCR in two years, supported by nationwide EV charging expansion. Three, real industrial inspections under third-party monitoring, and shutting down violators. Four, 24x7 dust monitoring with strict penalties for construction violations. Five, a central NCR clean air war room with daily reporting of action taken, not just AQI numbers. Six, national clean air roadmap with measurable targets and an independent compliance authority.

This is not just an environmental crisis; this is a human crisis. Toxic air is damaging the lungs, brains, hearts of the entire generation. In such situations, no nation can call itself developed. I urge the Government to stop gimmicks, stop excuses and start action. Our people are still literally gasping for breath.

SHRI K. E. PRAKASH (ERODE): Hon Chairperson Sir, It is a matter of great concern that the Union Government is not releasing the Disaster Relief funds meant for the State of Tamil Nadu at a time when the State is facing the ire of heavy rains due the North East Monsoon and Cyclone. Under the able leadership of Hon Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu Shri M.K. Stalin, Tamil Nadu Government has taken several initiatives pertaining to flood management systems and flood warning systems through Hon. Deputy Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu Shri Udhayanidhi Stalin, MPs, MLAs and Representatives of Local Bodies, in an effective manner. But in such a scenario, the Union Government has been delaying time and again the release of funds due for Tamil Nadu. From 2021 to 2025, Tamil Nadu Government has spent Rs. 9,170.48 Crore from its own funds for disaster management related work. This is double the amount that is actually allocated to Tamil Nadu by the Union Government. This is a perfect example to explain how Tamil Nadu Government is more concerned about the interests of the State. Union Government has not released Rs 826.5 Crore that is due for Tamil Nadu during current year. Out of which Rs 661.2 Crore is the funds under State Disaster Relief Fund (SDRF) and Rs 165.3 Crore is under State Disaster Mitigation Fund (STMF). These funds are to be released. Due to the adverse effect of cyclone and heavy rains in Tamil Nadu, the delay in the release of funds from the Union may hamper the State?s relief work. In this situation, Hon Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu had convened an urgent meeting of the State Disaster Mitigation Fund (SDMF) and had openly stated this to all. The State Government of Tamil Nadu has been implementing special measures in an effective manner needed at times of cyclone and floods, such as helping the displaced, relief centre, flood management, extending urgent relief measures, etc. Union Government should release funds well before the rains and rainy season. Even the experts warn that this delay in release of funds by the Union is dangerous and unfair. Every year, due to heavy rains and cyclones, the Coastal areas such as Chennai and Tuticorin are very much affected in Tamil Nadu. Tamil Nadu government is facing financial crisis and financial burden due to non-release of funds that are due for Tamil Nadu. This is totally unacceptable on our part. Therefore, on behalf of Tamil Nadu, I urge upon the Union Government to provide the amount of Rs 826.5 Crore that is due for Tamil Nadu without any further delay. Can there be an assurance from the Union Government for release of this fund at the earliest. If not they should cite the reasons for the delay in a a candid manner. Long live Tamil. श्री विजय कुमार दूबे (कुशीनगर): महोदय, मेरा विषय खेल से संबंधित है । वर्तमान समय में इस देश के ग्रामीण अंचल के युवाओं को खेल विभाग से जोड़ने के लिए भारत सरकार ने इस देश की धरती पर कई योजनाएं लागू की हैं । यशस्वी प्रधानमंत्री माननीय मोदी जी के ?फिट इंडिया? और ?खेलो इंडिया? अभियान से वर्तमान समय में इस देश के ग्रामीण अंचल के युवा भी खेल-कूद से जुड़ने का कार्य कर रहे हैं । शायद सांसद खेल स्पर्धा भी इसी उद्देश्य की पूर्ति के लिए वर्तमान समय में चलाई जा रही है ।

कुमारी सैलजा (सिरसा): महोदय, मैं आपके माध्यम से सरकार का ध्यान हरियाणा राज्य विशेषकर सिरसा एवं उसके आस-पास के क्षेत्रों से जुड़े राष्ट्रीय राजमार्गों की अत्यंत खराब व खतरनाक स्थिति की ओर आकृष्ट करना चाहती हूं ।

महोदय, जनता कर भी देती है और टोल टैक्स भी देती है, पर उसे न ही सुरक्षित सड़कें मिलती हैं और न ही सुविधाएं मिलती हैं । सड़कें जीवन जोड़ने का माध्यम होनी चाहिए, न कि जीवन छीनने का कारण । सरकार ने कहा है एवं बहुत बड़े-बड़े दावे किए गए हैं, लेकिन आज राष्ट्रीय राजमार्गों की जो हालत हो चुकी है, वह सबके सामने है ।

महोदय, मेरे राज्य के अधिकांश राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग, विशेषकर दिल्ली-हिसार राजमार्ग जगह-जगह गड्ढों और जलभराव से भरे हुए हैं । इंजीनियरिंग खामियों के कारण सड़क की सतह असमान है । हर वर्ष सैकड़ों सड़क दुर्घटनाएं इनके कारण हो रही हैं । हर जगह खासतौर से ओवर ब्रिजेज़ के साइड्स को देखें, तो वहां पर जंगली पेड़-पौधे इस कदर उग गए हैं कि बहुत शीघ्र ही इन राष्ट्रीय राजमार्गों की स्थिति बिल्कुल खराब हो जाएगी ।

महोदय, मैं मांग करती हूं कि सभी हाइवेज़ की स्वतंत्र तकनीकी जांच करवाई जानी चाहिए । सभी हाइवेज़ गड्ढा मुक्त हों और समतल बनाए जाएं । सिरसा में बढ़ते ट्रैफिक का दबाव और प्रदूषण को देखते हुए दक्षिण बाईपास का निर्माण अति आवश्यक है । यह परियोजना वर्षों से प्रस्तावित है । उसके लिए न ही भूमि का अधिग्रहण हुआ है और न ही टेंडर प्रक्रिया शुरू हुई है । इसे प्राथमिकता दी जाए । 

महोदय, पंजाब, हरियाणा और राजस्थान को जालंधर-सिरसा-नोहर-तारानगर हाईवे जोड़ता है । इसका निर्माण कार्य अधूरा है । यह वर्षों से पड़ा हुआ है । इसे भी प्राथमिकता दी जाए । मंत्री जी ने खुद कहा था कि 60 किलोमीटर से कम दूरी पर टोल नहीं लगाया जाएगा, लेकिन सब जगह इसका उल्लंघन हो रहा है । इसका कड़ाई से पालन होना चाहिए । हिसार के दोनों तरफ 37 किलोमीटर की दूरी पर टोल प्लाज़ा लग गए हैं ।

महोदय, मैं यह भी मांग करूंगी कि टोल प्लाज़ाओं पर ग्रीन कॉरिडोर्स, स्ट्रीट लाइट्स, शौचालय और विश्राम स्थल जैसी नागरिक सुविधाएं तत्काल दुरुस्त की जाएं । पानी की निकासी हाईवेज़ के दोनों तरफ दिखाई तो जाती है, लेकिन आप सब जानते हैं और सारा हाउस जानता है कि उनमें किस तरह से भराव हो गया है, उनमें पौधे उग गए हैं और निकासी ठीक से नहीं हो रही है । मैंने अपनी ?दिशा? मीटिंग में भी इस बात को बार-बार उठाया है, लेकिन उस पर कोई कार्रवाई नहीं हो रही है । 

महोदय, मैं आखिर में एक और बात कहना चाहूंगी कि नेशनल हाईवे अथॉरिटी द्वारा पहले यह बताया गया था कि एनएच-9 पर डींग, साहुवाला, ओढान, चोरमार और सावंत खेड़ा में अंडरब्रिजेस बनाए जाएंगे । इस हेतु डीपीआर तैयार करने के आदेश दिए गए हैं, लेकिन मालूम पड़ा है कि डिंग कस्बे में जो अंडरब्रिज बनना था, वह काम शायद नहीं हो रहा है । इसलिए मैं मांग करूंगी कि वह भी किया जाए और सभी नेशनल हाईवेज़ की क्वॉलिटी पर ध्यान दिया जाए । धन्यवाद ।

Regarding need to strength India?s furniture manufacturing and export ecosystem

SHRI TANGELLA UDAY SRINIVAS: Hon. Chairperson, Sir, I rise to draw the attention of this august House to a vast yet under-recognized opportunity of need to urgently strengthen India?s furniture manufacturing and export ecosystem.

Furniture is one of the fastest growing consumer sectors in the world and is expected to cross USD 800 billion globally. India has all ingredients to lead this industry ? a skilled workforce, good timber resource, a rich craft tradition, and strong domestic and global demand. Yet our share in global furniture exports is just one per cent, far beyond much smaller economies like Vietnam and Malaysia. Even though we are one of the largest furniture producers in the world, India still imported almost half a billion dollars worth of furniture in 2023. This clearly shows gap in our manufacturing capacity, our product range, and our global competitiveness.

The challenges are well known. Nearly 85 per cent of furniture in the country is made by informal carpenters, which limits scaling up and standardization. High duties on engineered wood and fittings increase costs. We lack design centres, testing labs, and strong global branding. Our logistics, especially long distance from ports, make it harder for Indian exporters to compete. In this context, port-linked regions, like Kakinada with deep-draft facilities and land for integrated clusters, offer a major opportunity. Reducing logistics alone can significantly improve export competitiveness. This sector is labour intensive, innovation driven, and capable of creating lakhs of skilled jobs, formalizing artisans, boosting exports, and supporting timber plantations. What we need now is a focused national strategy.

Therefore, I request the Union Government to consider the following: establishing mega furniture parks with common CNC facilities, seasoning yards, and port-linked logistic hubs; launching a PLI scheme for furniture manufacturing as recommended by NITI Aayog; reducing import duties on engineered wood fittings and adhesives; setting up national design and skill institute for furniture, technology and industrial prototyping; and creating a branding and export promotion mission to showcase Indian furniture globally. Through right interventions, our MSMEs can grow into global manufacturers and make India a strong and trusted player in international furniture value chain.

श्री योगेन्द्र चांदोलिया (उत्तर-पश्चिम दिल्ली): सभापति जी, मैं आपके माध्यम से माननीय शिक्षा मंत्री का ध्यान इस तरफ दिलाना चाहता हूं और उनसे मांग करता हूं कि भारत में 668 पीएम श्री जवाहर नवोदय विद्यालय हैं, जिनके टीचर्स को पेंशन का लाभ नहीं मिलता है । मैं नवोदय विद्यालय की टीचिंग कम्युनिटी के साथ हो रहे अन्याय की ओर ध्यान खींचने के लिए खड़ा हुआ हूं । भारत देश में 668 नवोदय विद्यालय चल रहे हैं, जिनमें हजारों शिक्षक काम करते हैं । ये शिक्षक बिना किसी अवकाश के 24 घंटे कार्य कर रहे हैं ।

*Regarding need to bring a Legislation to protect the houses and livelihood of people of Vennaimalai in Karur District

SUSHRI S. JOTHIMANI (KARUR): Hon Chairperson Sir, Vanakkam. Thankyou for this opportunity. I have already raised brought this issue in this august House for the attention of Union Government. I once again raise this issue. In Vennaimalai of Karur District, people who are living in Inam (endowment) land with proper patta (the ownership right) should be protected from being vacated on the basis of a Court Order. Every week and on every Fridays, the people of this area have sleepless nights and lots of fear in mind because the houses and shops are sealed quoting Contempt of Court Order. These are not temple lands as viewed by the Courts. These are lands which were donated to those who offered service to God since the last century. Therefore this land belongs to them. The ownership rights have been properly registered in the names of these families. Patta or the document of ownership right has been acquired by the owners of this Inam land 30 years ago. They have even purchased this land by paying money in a legal manner. Registration has also been done by the government after payment of required stamp duties by them. Property tax has been levied and property owners has the receipts of this payment. Banks also had given loans to buy these properties as they possessed Patta for several generations. How can they be considered as encroachers? In the name of temples and on the basis of court orders how fair it is to force them to vacate their houses? There are no answers for these simple questions. They claim that these people are engaged in commercial activities. Their shops are sealed by referring to Court orders as they run a small tea shop in front their homes. Can?t they have small restaurant in front of their homes? How can this be considered as a crime? Whether our people have constructed multi-storied buildings and having business in a large scale? They are having only residences. What will they do for their livelihood? How will they educate their children? How can they run their families? They have Patta in their names. If it is so, how can it be illegal to have small businesses? This issue doesn't only pertain to Vennaimalai, Pugzhali Malai, Venjamankudalur areas but it has a larger area. The same person has filed a case in the Court regarding 20 such temple lands in Karur district. If such a situation continues, Karur district which had name and fame during the Chera dynasty will completely disappear. Both the Union and State governments have to shoulder responsibility in protecting Karur district. Even if Tamil Nadu government issues Order for protection of such affected people in Karur, within 2 hours of issuance of such an Order, the Opposite parties approach the Courts and get those Orders them stayed. Eyes filled with tears and sorrows of our people are giving us so much pain. With introduction of one particular bill, the State of Kashmir has been changed onto a Union Territory. Can't government find a solution to the affected people of Vennaimalai? This issue has further aggravated and as much as 13 lakh acres of temple land throughout Tamil Nadu is under threat. Several thousands of people have been facing unbearable sorrow and suffering. In consultation with State government, I urge that the Union government should bring a legislation to protect the houses and livelihood of people of Tamil Nadu particularly of Vennaimalai in Karur district. Thank you.

PROF. SOUGATA RAY (DUM DUM): Sir, I rise to speak during the ?Zero Hour? on the deprivation enforced by the Central Government on West Bengal. 

The total due on 100-days work is Rs. 52,000 crore. The total dues to West Bengal is Rs. 2 lakh crore; 59 lakh workers are involved; Disaster Relief Fund due is Rs. 43,000 crore; Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana due is Rs. 60,100 crore; Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan due is Rs. 19,000 crore; and Jal Jeevan Mission due is Rs. 2,500 crore. The Calcutta High Court, in a judgment, said that all these dues, especially in MGNREGA should be paid by 1st August, 2025. The Union Government has not kept the promise. It is delaying it, and the Finance Minister is making wrong statements in the Parliament in the matter. The appeal of the Centre went to the Supreme Court. The Supreme Court has rejected the Union Government?s appeal. 

We immediately demand that the MGNREGA, which is stopped from 2022, be restored and the funds given. I strongly protest against the discriminatory attitude of the Central Government towards West Bengal, which is being protested by 59 lakh workers all together in the State. 

Thank you.

श्री मनीश तिवारी (चंडीगढ़) : सभापति महोदय, बहुत-बहुत धन्‍यवाद । चंडीगढ़ के आसपास तीन शहर मोहाली, पंचकुला और न्‍यू चं‍डीगढ़ हैं । नवंबर, 2019 में मैंने Minister of Road Transport and Highways और Minister of Housing and Urban Affairs को एक खत लिखा था कि इन चारों शहरों को आपस में जोड़ने की जरूरत है और एक मास रैपिड ट्रांसपोर्ट सिस्‍टम बनाने की आवश्‍यकता है, जिससे कि इस पूरे रीजन की इकोनॉमिक पोटेंशियल को पूरी तरह से जागरूक किया जा सके । मैंने यह प्रस्‍ताव दिया था कि अंबाला से लेकर कुराली तक और लांड्रा से लेकर पिंजौर तक एक मास रैपिड ट्रांसपोर्ट सिस्‍टम बनाया जाए । सरकार ने उस पहल के ऊपर एक यूनिफाइड मेट्रोपोलिटन ट्रांसपोर्ट अथॉरिटी का गठन किया, परंतु दुर्भाग्‍यपूर्ण बात यह है कि वह जो यूनिफाइड मेट्रोपोलिटन ट्रांसपोर्ट अथॉरिटी है, जब से उसका गठन हुआ है, तब से उसकी बैठक सिर्फ तीन बार ही हुई हैं । उन्‍होंने रेलवे टेक्निकल इकोनॉमिक अथॉरिटी (राइट्स) को यह कहा कि एक फिजिबिलिटी रिपोर्ट दीजिए कि इन चारों शहरों के लिए एक मेट्रो बन सकती है या नहीं? राइट्स ने दो बार रिपोर्ट दी कि हां, इन चारों शहरों को जोड़ने के लिए मेट्रो आवश्‍यक है और मेट्रो बनाने की जरूरत है ।

लेकिन उसके ऊपर आगे कोई कार्रवाई नहीं हुई । पिछले तीन-चार वर्षों में उस प्रोजेक्‍ट की कॉस्‍ट धीरे-धीरे बढ़कर 16 हजार करोड़ रुपये से 25 हजार करोड़ रुपये हो गई है ।

सभापति महोदय, नागपुर में मेट्रो बन गई, कोच्‍ची में मेट्रो बन गई, बेंगलुरु में मेट्रो बन गई, हैदराबाद में मेट्रो बन गई और मुम्‍बई में भी मेट्रो बन गई । तमाम शहरों में मेट्रो बन गई है, लेकिन चंडीगढ़ में पिछले 10 साल से मेट्रो नहीं बनी है । मेरी केन्‍द्र सरकार से यह स्‍पेसिफिक मांग है कि सरकार को इसे स्‍ट्रेटेजिक कनेक्ट‍िविटी प्रोजेक्‍ट के तहत एडॉप्‍ट करते हुए 25 हजार करोड़ रुपये केन्‍द्र सरकार की तरफ से देना चाहिए, जिससे यह सारा रीजन इंटीग्रेट हो सके और इसकी जो इकोनॉमिक पौटेंशियल है, उसे कैटेलाइज किया जा सके । आपका बहुत-बहुत धन्‍यवाद ।

Regarding need to disburse complete sum of crop insurance to farmers of Karnataka

SHRI KOTA SRINIVASA POOJARY (UDUPI CHIKMAGALUR): Hon?ble Chairpeson, Sir, 

There are complaints that lakhs of farmers have not received their crop insurance payments. On behalf all those farmers, I urge the central government in this regard. In my state of Karnataka, there has been an allegation that in Chikkamagalur district alone, there are 39,000 farmers were not received their crop insurance. Sir, in some places, there are complaint that the farmers were not received even the premium amount paid by them for the crop insurance. I urge the central government through you that there are complaints about the rain gauge installed in the rural areas are damaged. Farmers have been vocally expressing their annoyance that they must turn to consumer courts in order to receive the premium amount they have paid. Sir, a scenario has developed in which farmers from the Chikmagaluru, Tarikere, Mudigere, and Sringeri constituencies have taken to streets for protesting as there were ill-treated by the insurance companies and causing inordinate delay to make the payment of crop insurance. caus claiming they have been treated unfairly due to the delayed release of crop insurance. It is not only of Shivamogga and Uttara Kannada districts, but farmers from all over the state are agitating over the delay caused by the insurance companies in releasing the payment of crop insurance. Hence, I urge upon the hon?ble Union Minister for Agriculture through you to sought a report from the Chief Secretary of the Government of Karnataka and also the Deputy Commissioners of all the 31 districts of the state to ensure that the complete sum of crop insurance is disbursed without further delay.
